newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says textile exports $229 mln in eight months.
newsitem.headline: Iran says textile exports $229 mln in eight months.

text.p: Iran exported textiles worth $229 million in the eight months to November 1996, up 76 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Monday.

It quoted Mohammad Hassan Maddah, an official of the Industry Ministry's textile and clothing department, as also saying hard currency allocations to the department "increased to $100 million" in the current Iranian year ending on March 20.
An Iranian official said in July hard cash earmarked for the textile industry by the ministry would be $535 million in the year. The reason for the apparent discrepency was not immediately clear.
Iran has said it exported $163 million in fabrics and clothing, mostly to Europe and central Asian states, in the year that ended on March 19, 1996.
